metric_definitions.num_connections: Prerequisite edges within the program subgraph
metric_definitions.density: Edges / (n(n-1)/2). Uses the convention of a directed numerator over an undirected maximum, so values can exceed 0.5.
metric_definitions.cross_program_share: Share of courses also required by another program
metric_definitions.avg_unlocks: Mean out-degree within the program subgraph
metric_definitions.modularity_proxy: Connected components of the undirected subgraph
metric_definitions.avg_prereqs: Mean in-degree within the program subgraph
metric_definitions.cross_dept_pct: Share of courses owned by another department
metric_definitions.gateway_count: Courses required by 5 or more programs
